# Maxora Technology

> Maxora Technology is a software development and digital engineering agency serving growing businesses worldwide, with regional presence in Punjab, India. The company builds custom web applications, mobile apps, CRM/ERP systems, and e-commerce platforms.

## Core Information

- Website: https://maxoratechnology.com
- Contact Email: [info@maxoratechnology.com]
- Phone: +91 7719545464
- Geographic Service Scope: Worldwide & India
- Primary Focus: Custom Software Engineering, Next.js/React Web Applications, Mobile App Development (React Native & Flutter), Custom CRM/ERP Systems, E-Commerce Development, WordPress Engineering, and Technical SEO & AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

## Services & Solutions

- [Services Overview](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services): Comprehensive suite of engineering and software development capabilities.
- [Custom Web Development](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/web-development): High-performance web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- [Mobile App Development](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/app-development): Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter and React Native.
- [Custom CRM & ERP Systems](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/crm-erp): Tailored business management systems, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
- [E-Commerce Platforms](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/ecommerce): High-converting online stores built on Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless commerce architectures.
- [WordPress Solutions](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/wordpress): Bespoke Gutenberg block themes, custom plugin engineering, and site speed optimization.
- [Technical SEO & AEO Services](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/seo-aeo): Core Web Vitals engineering, Schema.org entity graphs, extractable content answer blocks, and AI engine citation optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
